lead.headline: Apple Pay arrives in India, starting with Axis Bank credit cards
lead.deck: Apple Pay went live in India on Wednesday on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, with support for the Mac to follow. At launch it takes only Axis Bank's Visa and Mastercard credit cards, for tap-to-pay in shops and for payments in apps and online. Apple names Blinkit, Croma, ixigo, Reliance brands, Tata 1mg and Zomato among the merchants.
